api_host.documentation: Where events are sent: https://api-eu.mixpanel.com for a project with EU data residency (the default), https://api.mixpanel.com for US, https://api-in.mixpanel.com for India, or your own proxy. Must start with https://.

token.documentation: The project token from your Mixpanel project settings. Nothing is loaded or sent until it is set.

trackClicks.documentation: Send an event for every click in the report (not inside other custom views), with the clicked element's Omniscope name. Off: only an event when the report opens.

sendUser.documentation: Add the signed-in Omniscope user's identity to every event. Off: events are anonymous apart from Mixpanel's own device ID.

showNotice.documentation: Show a one-line notice in the view telling viewers that their use of the report is recorded.
